environment: Native Three geometry, instancing, and CPU rasterizer; browser checks separate

checks.name: only blockers between camera and player fade, without changing shared material
scenery behind player and low ground do not fade
leaving an obstruction restores layers and visibility after the short anti-flicker hold
individual tree instances fade and restore, while neighbouring trees stay intact
fade eases and reduced motion switches instantly
CPU renderer actually reveals player pixels through the transparent wall
cleanup disposes owned materials only and restores original source meshes
